notes:
Account snapshot: Sable Clinical Retrieval is a mid-sized health system technology org building an internal clinical documentation search product for physicians and coding teams. Primary driver: fast, precise retrieval from 120M+ historical notes and scanned reports with strict PHI controls.

Key constraints: must support private networking (VPC or on-prem), full per-request audit logs, SSO via SAML, and customer-managed KMS/HSM. Data residency: US-only. They expect zero cross-tenant data exposure and want an option to run embeddings generation and similarity search inside their VPC or on-prem cluster.

Performance targets heard on call: "sub-200ms median to top-k retrieval for triage queries; rerank end-to-end under 400ms for clinician UX". Cost sensitivity: willing to pay up front for Dedicated/Private to avoid per-query surprises; interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions to keep unit cost < $0.0008 per 1K tokens for embedding pipelines (note: they phrased as "keep embeddings cost predictable").

Model stack preference: bi-encoder for initial vector retrieval (quantized 8-bit), cross-encoder (or lightweight cross-attention re-ranker) for top-50 rerank; fallback to smaller cross-encoders when latency spikes. Interested in model fingerprinting and rollout controls.

Quote from CISO: "We will not push PHI outside our VPC for production — POC can be isolated but must show auditability."

POC dataset: 5M de-identified progress notes + 2M radiology reports (PII-scrub pipeline required). They are ok with a staged POC: hosted private with strict egress controls -> dedicated on customer-managed infra.

Sales context: procurement timeline aggressive if security checks green; procurement lead is VP Product (Elena Ruiz). Wants a pricing/compliance binder for internal review.
